function: DDPG agent jointly sets VLC and mmWave beamforming weights, mirror angles, mmWave IRS phase shifts and the VLC/mmWave power ratio to maximize secrecy capacity (p. 8).
system: Indoor: 4 VLC fixtures with 49-mirror IRS; mmWave AP with V antennas, passive reflecting IRS of 8-64 elements, single-antenna user; mmWave carrier frequency not stated (p. 5, 7, 10).
method: Single-agent DDPG actor-critic reinforcement learning, 1000 episodes of 1000 iterations, state is the positions of Bob and Eve (p. 8-10).
data_channel: Own simulator: VLC mirror-array IRS irradiance model from [31], mmWave IRS path loss with array response, random-waypoint user motion; no 3GPP model or public dataset (p. 5-7).
test_conditions: Training curves of 1000 episodes in one 10x10 m room with random-waypoint users, per number of mmWave IRS elements (8-64); no separate test or unseen scenario (p. 10-12).
baselines: None: only its own VLC-only, mmWave-only and hybrid configurations and Bob versus Eve rates are compared; no classical or learned baseline (p. 10-11).
metrics: Secrecy capacity and rates of Bob and Eve on log scale, VLC/mmWave power ratio, reward convergence over episodes and iterations (p. 10-12).
q1_support: p. 6: "Geometrical analysis, as detailed in [31], can be used to derive the closed-form definition" for the VLC link; p. 7 (Eq. 15) uses a generic mmWave path-loss term with an array response; no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data.
q2_support: p. 10: "we conducted 1000 episodes to train the system simulation"; the results are these training curves in one room, with no separate test, unseen scenario or adaptation, and the network size follows the IRS element count (p. 9), so each setting is its own run.
q3_support: p. 10: "We simulate the SC of the system in three different cases" (VLC only, mmWave only, both links), which are variants of the proposed system; no classical or learned baseline appears in Figs. 7-12.
q4_support: p. 9: "Each network comprises four hidden layers" and p. 10: "determines the output size of the network" only describe the architecture; no order of complexity, FLOPs, parameter count or runtime is given.
q5_support: p. 10: "Table 1 presents the DDPG agent" and simulation parameters of its own simulator; the paper gives no code or data link, no repository and no public dataset.
notes: Title on p. 1 matches the DOI. Area 3 although the objective is secrecy capacity: the learned function is beamforming and RIS configuration (phase shifts, mirror angles); physical-layer security is not among the excluded functions, so the reviewer should confirm that secure beamforming counts. q4 is borderline: the section titled complexity discussion (pp. 9-10) only describes network sizes. Number of mmWave AP antennas V and mmWave carrier frequency are not given. Table 1 and Figs. 7-12 were read as images.
